project: MSF Companion — Commander Wallet: Manual Gold & Cores → Affordability Planning
description: Let a commander enter their Gold and Power Cores once (the only two progression currencies the MSF API does NOT expose) so the app's existing cost machinery graduates from advice into a real 'can I afford it / what am I short on' answer — especially for the outcome-first question 'What will it cost to unlock character X, and can I afford it now?'. Additive and optional: all existing planner/offers views keep working with no wallet; entering balances upgrades them. Full spec incl. per-story Test Cases with explicit pass criteria: tasks/prd-commander-wallet.md. Approved UX mockup: wallet-integration-mockup.html (4 screens).

userStories.title: Wallet data model & persistence
userStories.description: As a commander, I want my Gold and Cores stored on my account so I only enter them once.
acceptanceCriteria: Prisma model CommanderWallet with gold (Int/BigInt), cores (Int), confirmedAt (DateTime), updatedAt, and a unique relation to the account/user (one wallet per account)
Migration created; npx prisma migrate status is internally consistent
Values are non-negative integers; absent/null wallet is a valid state (feature is optional)
Persisting {gold, cores} and reading back by account returns the same values with a valid confirmedAt
A second wallet row for the same account is rejected by the unique constraint
Typecheck passes
npx next build succeeds
All TC-001.* pass criteria in tasks/prd-commander-wallet.md are met

userStories.title: Wallet read/write API
userStories.description: As a commander, I want endpoints to read and update my wallet so the UI can load and save it.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/msf/wallet returns { gold, cores, confirmedAt } or an explicit empty/absent state; 401 when unauthenticated
PUT /api/msf/wallet accepts { gold, cores }, validates non-negative integers, sets confirmedAt = now, returns saved wallet; 401 unauthenticated; 400 on invalid input
Wallet is scoped to the authenticated account only (no cross-account read/write)
PUT then GET round-trips the same values; a second PUT updates confirmedAt to a strictly later time
Unit/integration tests cover validation, auth (401), account isolation, and round-trip persistence
Typecheck passes
All TC-002.* pass criteria in tasks/prd-commander-wallet.md are met

userStories.title: Wallet input sheet
userStories.description: As a commander, I want a simple 2-field sheet to enter Gold and Cores so setup is trivial.
acceptanceCriteria: Mobile-first sheet with two numeric inputs (Gold, Cores), thousands-formatted display (e.g. 1,840,000) while sending raw integers to the API, matching app theme tokens
Save calls PUT /api/msf/wallet; a 'Skip for now' path dismisses without saving and without creating a wallet
Helper text explains these two values aren't in the API and are stored as self-reported
Non-numeric and negative values are rejected gracefully; Save is blocked until valid
Save failure (400/500) surfaces an error and does not falsely report success or close as saved
Typecheck passes
All TC-003.* pass criteria in tasks/prd-commander-wallet.md are met

userStories.title: Wallet strip on Planner
userStories.description: As a commander, I want to see my wallet at the top of the planner so my balances are always in context.
acceptanceCriteria: /planner renders a 'Your Wallet' strip above existing event cards showing Gold + Cores formatted, with a 'self-reported' label and 'confirmed Nd ago' derived from confirmedAt

When no wallet exists, the strip shows an 'Add your wallet' first-run prompt (not zeros) that opens the input sheet
Existing planner readiness bars/cards render unchanged when the strip is present
Existing planner unit/e2e tests still pass

userStories.title: Cost bundle engine (gold + training-XP + mats)
userStories.description: As the system, I want to compute the full resource cost to take a character from its current state to a target so affordability can be evaluated.
acceptanceCriteria: A pure function computes CostBundle { gold, cores, abilityMats: Record<itemId,qty>, trainingXp } for a character delta (current gear/level/stars -> target), with no network/DB calls (data passed in)
Reuses upgrade-calculator.ts for gear/ability/star item costs; adds training-XP level cost (documented per-level XP curve) and gold cost (documented source; resolve Open Question #1)
Handles unowned character (full cost from zero) and already-meets-target (zero cost) cases
Known gear/level fixture delta yields expected quantities (mats/gold/trainingXp) matching the cost book fixture exactly
Unit tests cover known delta, zero-cost, unowned, level-XP, and purity
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
All TC-005.* pass criteria in tasks/prd-commander-wallet.md are met

userStories.title: Affordability comparison
userStories.description: As a commander, I want to know whether I can afford a cost bundle so I can decide what to build.
acceptanceCriteria: A pure function compares a CostBundle against { wallet.gold, wallet.cores, api.abilityMats, api.trainingXp } and returns per-resource { required, have, short } plus overall affordable: boolean
Gracefully degrades: with no wallet, gold/cores are reported as 'unknown' (not 'short'), verdict is 'wallet needed', and mats/XP are still evaluated (no false negative)
Boundary have == required counts as affordable (>= inclusive); empty CostBundle is affordable regardless of wallet
Unit tests cover affordable, short-on-one-resource, no-wallet, boundary, zero-cost, and purity
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
All TC-006.* pass criteria in tasks/prd-commander-wallet.md are met

userStories.title: Cost-vs-wallet bill + verdict
userStories.description: As a commander, I want the total cost to complete an outcome compared against my wallet so I get one clear 'can I afford this' answer.
acceptanceCriteria: The 'Unlock X' view shows a cost table with rows Gold, Cores, Ability Mats, Training XP — each with required, have, and a have/short indicator (bars per mockup)
A single top-line verdict: 'affordable now' or 'short by X'
Aggregates cost across all under-gate characters for all blocking teams, deduping shared characters (counted once); table totals equal the summed per-character CostBundle values from US-005
Falls back cleanly to 'Add wallet' when no wallet is set (gold/cores 'unknown'; mats + XP still show real values; no false short verdict)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Staleness nudge
userStories.description: As a commander, I want a gentle reminder to reconfirm my balances so the numbers stay trustworthy.
acceptanceCriteria: When confirmedAt is older than the threshold (7 days), the wallet strip shows a subtle 'confirm your gold?' nudge with a one-tap edit; no nudge when newer than the threshold
One-tap opens the pre-filled input sheet; saving updates confirmedAt to now and clears the nudge
Nudge is non-blocking and dismissible; dismissing hides it for the session and never overwrites values automatically
Typecheck passes
All TC-011.* pass criteria in tasks/prd-commander-wallet.md are met
